domain_restrictions: d is a real number with 0 <= d
d is a real number with d < 1/n
t is a real number with t in [0,d], meaning 0 <= t and t <= d
target membership t in [0,1/n) means 0 <= t and t < 1/n
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all positive integers n and all real numbers d and t, if 0 <= d and d < 1/n and 0 <= t and t <= d, then 0 <= t and t < 1/n.

variables.name: n
variables.role: parameter controlling the upper bound 1 over n

witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses are introduced; all variables are universally quantified

statement_nl: For every positive integer n, every real number d with 0 ≤ d < 1/n, and every real t belonging to the interval [0,d], one has t ∈ [0,1/n).
